easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
It is your upkeep step.
description:
During your upkeep, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Treachery from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim.
When Treachery enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Treachery, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
